neighbours.label: a school or university context right before the title of its head: fires on the word leading into chancellor / principal / president / headteacher (' vice', ' school', ' departing')
fire: The new rules were explained by the university's vice chancellor at a staff meeting.
Parents sent a letter to the school principal about the broken heating.
At graduation the college's outgoing president shook every student's hand.
The strike ended after talks with the university's vice chancellor.
Every morning the school principal greets pupils at the gate.
The appointment of the university's vice president for research was announced today.
The teachers met the school's deputy headteacher after lessons.
A statement from the college's vice principal was read to the students.
quiet: The new rules were explained by the company's vice chairman at a staff meeting.
Parents sent a letter to the bus company about the broken heating.
At the wedding the bride's proud father shook every guest's hand.
The strike ended after talks with the airline's chief pilot.
Every morning the shop owner greets customers at the door.
The appointment of the bank's vice president for lending was announced today.
The teachers met the students' parents after lessons.
A statement from the union's vice chairman was read to the workers.

notes: Probing: "the university's vice chancellor" 0.81, 'the school principal' 0.52, "the college's departing president" 0.44; "the company's vice president" 0.05, team captain 0.05, hospital's chief surgeon 0.02, schools without a head 0.06-0.07. The output direction promotes principal/vice/head. So it needs both the educational institution and the upcoming head title.
